observed.caption: Elevated wide view of a dense city skyline with high-rise towers, a foreground building with a large billboard, and a busy road along the right edge under hazy daylight.
observed.description: The photo shows an elevated wide view of a dense urban cityscape under hazy daylight. Prominent high-rise buildings dominate the scene, including a tall light-colored rectangular tower on the right and a cylindrical brown tower with a flat rooftop structure on the left. A stepped, light-colored building with a large advertisement billboard occupies the center-foreground, surrounded by smaller mid-rise buildings, patches of green trees, and a multi-lane road with numerous small vehicles along the right edge. The background extends to a sprawling low-rise urban area fading into a pale hazy sky.
